entities.summary: Jonas (Jean) Otter was a Swedish traveler in the Ottoman and Persian Empires, known for his book Voyage en Turquie et en Perse, avec une Relation des Expeditions de Tahmas-Kouli-Khan (1748), based on his ten years in the Middle East.
